title: Morphogenesis is behaviour of cell collectives navigating anatomical morphospace

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Morphogenesis is behaviour of cell collectives navigating anatomical morphospace

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: Morphogenesis can be viewed as behaviour in anatomical morphospace: cellular collectives actively navigate from various starting states to the region corresponding to the species-specific target morphology, with competency ranging from a constrained random walk to advanced problem-solving, a framing Levin presents as a useful metaphor for importing tools from behavioural and cognitive science.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: The Multiscale Wisdom of the Body: Collective Intelligence as a Tractable Interface for Next-Generation Biomedicine

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Levin M 2025, The Multiscale Wisdom of the Body: Collective Intelligence as a Tractable Interface for Next-Generation Biomedicine › The Collective Intelligence of Cell Groups › Morphogenesis as Behavior in Anatomical Space

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: We previously argued that morphogenesis can be viewed as behavior in anatomical morphospace [13]; on this model, cellular collectives are systems that actively navigate from various starting states to a region corresponding to the species‐specific target morphology (Figure 2).

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Levin M, “The Multiscale Wisdom of the Body: Collective Intelligence as a Tractable Interface for Next-Generation Biomedicine”, BioEssays : news and reviews in molecular, cellular and developmental biology (2025), doi:10.1002/bies.202400196; section “The Collective Intelligence of Cell Groups › Morphogenesis as Behavior in Anatomical Space”. Scope: Developing and regenerating multicellular organisms

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2025-wisdom-06: not-empirically-resolvable, resolvability 0.15

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Cell and tissue trajectories can be quantified, but no possible trajectory selects the behavioural vocabulary over mechanistic rivals. The claim therefore lacks a discriminating empirical consequence as stated.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: The paper explicitly presents this as a framing; observed morphogenetic trajectories are equally compatible with describing development as navigation, dynamical relaxation or ordinary morphogenesis.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Morphospace navigation is metaphorical without an independent criterion.

Useful framing is not a biological outcome.

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Arrival at a target morphology from different starting conditions is the familiar content of regulative development. The claim's distinctive content is to treat that process as behavior in morphospace and as a reason to import cognitive tools. No public dataset distinguishes that cognitive description from a non-cognitive description of the same morphogenetic facts.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Regulative development already records movement from varied starts to a species-typical anatomy. Describing that record as behavior, navigation, or problem-solving does not add an observation that would distinguish it from the anatomical description.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Competency from random walk to advanced problem-solving has no separate measurement scale in existing anatomical data.

The text presents the framing as a useful metaphor.
